products.description:
Going above and beyond regular sun protection, the fresh Kombucha Multi-Defense Sheer UV SPF PA50++++ (50ml) promises to defend, boost luminosity, smooth and balance, all with an invisible finish. 
 Powered by double-fermented kombucha, this fluid-like formula lends antioxidant defence against dulling pollutants to keep complexions looking bright. Added lingonberry extract and vitamin C help to unify tone over time, too, all while its broad-spectrum protection benefits shield out solar rays.
